name: test_storybook
description: Drupal SDC component library with Storybook

scripts.lint: npm run lint:scss && npm run lint:js
scripts.dev: npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.dev:watch: concurrently -n lint,build -c cyan,green "nodemon --watch src --watch assets/icons --ext scss,js,yml,twig,svg --ignore 'dist/**' --exec 'npm run lint'" "nodemon --watch src --watch assets/icons --ext scss,js,yml,twig,svg --ignore 'dist/**' --exec 'node build/build.js'"
scripts.storybook: npm run storybook:prestart && storybook dev -p 6006 --config-dir config/.storybook
scripts.develop: concurrently -n build,lint,storybook -c green,cyan,magenta "npm run build:watch" "nodemon --watch src --watch assets --ext scss,js,yml,twig,svg --ignore 'dist/**' --exec 'npm run lint'" "npm run storybook"
